title: Named gradient as angle and color stops
summary: Store a gradient as a name, an angle and ordered color stops so an agent can recreate it with the project color system instead of copying a class stylesheet.
when_to_use: The user wants a reusable background gradient and can name its role.
avoid_when: A flat semantic color already does the job, or the user forbade decorative gradients.

anatomy.purpose: Identifies the gradient by role, not by a one-off class from a sample library.
Lists colors and their positions from 0 to 100 percent.

tokens.name: gradient.stop.0
tokens.purpose: Starting color at the first position.

tokens.name: gradient.stop.100
tokens.purpose: Ending color at the last position.

responsive: Keep the same stop roles when the background is cropped by a shorter viewport.
accessibility: Do not place body text on a gradient unless every region the text crosses still meets contrast.
implementation_steps: Choose or define a named role for the gradient.
Record angle and stops as data.
Emit the equivalent in the user stack, such as CSS variables, a theme object or a native brush.
Do not import an entire third-party gradient stylesheet just to use one ramp.
